about.title: About Me
about.intro: Full Stack Engineer with a Graphics Engineering foundation, now building a new focus as a reference in AI-supported software engineering — available for freelance projects and open to full-time engagements.
about.experience: My work spans global brands: 3D product configurators for Volvo and Jeep, checkout infrastructure at adidas supporting transactions across 30+ countries, and real-time architectural visualizations for Amarilo and other real estate leaders through Umbra 3D Studio. I work across the full stack — from React, Three.js and Angular on the frontend to Node.js, CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes on the systems side. In 2026 I've shifted focus toward AI-supported software engineering: I lead a workshop on Spec Driven Development and build daily with Claude Code, NotebookLM and similar tools, aiming to become a reference for teams adopting AI-augmented engineering practices.
about.tagline: I write code in OOP; I think in Matrix 4x4; I celebrate in salsa.
